Grace Mensah leaves in 34 days (25 Nov 2026). 1 critical and 0 at-risk areas need a handover; 3 areas are already covered by others.

**Recommended successor:** Priya Raman: 26% of the Bluebird Airlines account activity; Grace answered their Bluebird Airlines account questions 2 times; 1 open ticket
